name: Quark Woven Oddities
description: Turns on Quark Woven's Oddities content: backpacks, crates, pipes, magnets, matrix enchanting, the totem of holding and the tiny potato. Like Quark Oddities on Forge, this mod only flags the content as wanted; everything else is in Quark Woven. Unofficial port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Quark team.
